description: Kannel smppbox - all servers, per server and per customer (ESME)

panels.title: Gateway / Build Information
panels.description:
Identity of every smppbox server as reported in its status page: Kannel product and version, build date, hostname and IP, OS kernel, response mode (ack / immediate) and MySQL client version. State shows 'running' when smppbox is healthy.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: max by (server, product, version, build, hostname, host_ip, os_release, mysql_client, state, resp_mode) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Peak Inbound (msg/s)
panels.description:
Highest inbound rate of all selected servers combined in the selected time range. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: max_over_time(sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])

panels.title: Peak Outbound (msg/s)
panels.description:
Highest outbound rate of all selected servers combined in the selected time range. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: max_over_time(sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="sent"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])

panels.title: Current Inbound (msg/s)
panels.description:
Inbound rate of all selected servers combined, right now. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[1m]))

panels.title: Current Outbound (msg/s)
panels.description:
Outbound rate of all selected servers combined, right now. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="sent"}[1m]))

panels.title: Peak throughput per server
panels.description:
Peak and current inbound/outbound rate for each smppbox server. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: max by (server) ((max_over_time(sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])) and on (server) group by (server) (smppbox_up{server=~"$server"} == 1))

max by (server) ((max_over_time(sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="sent"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])) and on (server) group by (server) (smppbox_up{server=~"$server"} == 1))
max by (server) ((sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[1m]))) and on (server) group by (server) (smppbox_up{server=~"$server"} == 1))
max by (server) ((sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="sent"}[1m]))) and on (server) group by (server) (smppbox_up{server=~"$server"} == 1))

panels.title: Peak throughput per server & customer
panels.description:
Peak and current inbound/outbound rate for each customer on each server. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((max_over_time(sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((max_over_time(sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[1m]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[1m]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

panels.title: Peak throughput per server, customer & session
panels.description:
Peak and current rate for every single SMPP session (source IP + port + bind type) of every customer. Rates here are the in/out msg/s that smppbox itself reports per session. Requires 'per_session_metrics: true' in smpp_exporter.yml. Inbound = messages the customers submit TO smppbox (submit_sm). Outbound = messages smppbox sends TO the customers (DLR/MO). 'Peak' = highest 1-minute average msg/s inside the time range selected at top-right; 'Current' = last minute.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top. Also follows the Bind type filter.

targets.expr: max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) ((max_over_time(smppbox_session_in_rate{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) (smppbox_session_online_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) ((max_over_time(smppbox_session_out_rate{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) (smppbox_session_online_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) ((smppbox_session_in_rate{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) (smppbox_session_online_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) ((smppbox_session_out_rate{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) (smppbox_session_online_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) ((smppbox_session_online_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip, port, type) (smppbox_session_online_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

panels.title: Servers UP
panels.description:
Number of smppbox servers whose status.xml page the exporter could read on its last scrape. If a server is missing here it is either down or its status page/password is wrong.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_up{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Servers DOWN
panels.description:
Number of smppbox servers whose status page could NOT be read (connection refused, timeout, bad XML). Anything above 0 needs attention.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: count(smppbox_up{server=~"$server"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Submit rate (MT)
panels.description:
Messages per second customers are submitting to smppbox right now (averaged over the graph resolution).

Direction: 'Submit' = submit_sm PDUs the customer sends TO smppbox (MT traffic). 'Deliver' = deliver_sm PDUs smppbox sends TO the customer (delivery reports / MO).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Deliver rate (DLR/MO)
panels.description:
Messages per second smppbox is delivering back to customers - mostly delivery reports (DLRs), plus any MO messages.

Direction: 'Submit' = submit_sm PDUs the customer sends TO smppbox (MT traffic). 'Deliver' = deliver_sm PDUs smppbox sends TO the customer (delivery reports / MO).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(rate(smppbox_esme_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failed rate
panels.description:
Messages per second smppbox counted as failed for the selected customers (rejected, throttled, invalid, or not acknowledged).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(rate(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failure %
panels.description:
Failed messages as a percentage of submitted messages. Green < 2 %, orange 2-5 %, red > 5 %.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.0001)

panels.title: Submitted (range)
panels.description:
Total messages submitted by the selected customers during the selected time range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(increase(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Failed (range)
panels.description:
Total failed messages for the selected customers during the selected time range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(increase(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Customers connected
panels.description:
Customers that currently have at least one SMPP session bound (any bind type).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: count(smppbox_esme_connected{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Customers disconnected
panels.description:
Customers that are configured (or were recently seen) but have NO session bound right now. They cannot send traffic until they reconnect.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: count(smppbox_esme_connected{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description:
Total number of SMPP binds (transceiver + transmitter + receiver) currently open by the selected customers.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"})

panels.title: Open acks
panels.description:
PDUs sent but not yet acknowledged (in flight). A high or growing value means the customer or the gateway is slow to respond (window full).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_esme_open_acks{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"})

panels.title: Queued msgs
panels.description:
Messages waiting in smppbox queues (towards bearerbox and towards customers). Should be near 0; a growing queue means traffic is not flowing out.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_queued_messages{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Store size
panels.description:
Messages held in the smppbox persistent store (waiting to be processed/resent). Should stay small.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_store_size_messages{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Bearerbox disconnected
panels.description:
Number of smppbox servers that lost their connection to bearerbox. If > 0 that server cannot route any traffic to the operator.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: count(smppbox_bearerbox_connected{server=~"$server"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: smppbox memory
panels.description:
Total memory used by the smppbox processes of the selected servers.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_memory_bytes{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Overall throughput
panels.description:
Gateway-wide PDUs per second. From ESMEs = submits from all customers; To ESMEs = deliveries to customers; To/From bearerbox = traffic between smppbox and bearerbox (the operator side).

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="bearerbox", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="bearerbox", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Submit rate per server
panels.description:
Customer submit rate split by smppbox server (stacked, so the top line is the total).

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Deliver (DLR/MO) rate per server
panels.description:
Deliveries (DLR/MO) to customers per server, stacked.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gateway-reported load (1m avg)
panels.description:
The load figures smppbox itself prints in status.xml (1-minute average). Use it to cross-check the exporter's own rates.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_load_messages_per_second{server=~"$server", window="1m"}

panels.title: Queues
panels.description:
Queued messages per server/side/direction and the store size over time. Flat at 0 is healthy.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_queued_messages{server=~"$server"}
smppbox_store_size_messages{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: Messages per interval (bars)
panels.description:
Messages submitted per graph interval per server - handy to see traffic shape through the day.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: sum by (server) (increase(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Server health
panels.description:
One row per smppbox server: reachability, bearerbox link, host, version, response mode, uptime, CPU (% of one core over 5 min), memory, configured logins, logins online, active sessions, current submit rate, store size and how long the status scrape took.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: max by (server) (smppbox_up{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_uptime_seconds{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (100 * rate(smppbox_cpu_seconds_total{server=~"$server"}[5m])) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_memory_bytes{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_logins_configured{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_logins_online{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_sessions_active{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(smppbox_messages_total{server=~"$server", side="esme", direction="received"}[5m]))) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_store_size_messages{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_bearerbox_connected{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server) (smppbox_scrape_duration_seconds{server=~"$server"}) * on (server) group_left (hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})
max by (server, hostname, host_ip, version, resp_mode, os_release) (smppbox_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: CPU usage (% of one core)
panels.description:
CPU used by smppbox. 100 % = one full CPU core.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: 100 * rate(smppbox_cpu_seconds_total{server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: Memory
panels.description:
Memory used by smppbox per server. A steady climb may indicate a leak.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_memory_bytes{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: Active sessions per server
panels.description:
Number of SMPP binds open on each server (stacked).

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_sessions_active{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: Customer overview
panels.description:
One row per customer (ESME system-id) per server.
Status = CONNECTED if at least one session is bound, else DISCONNECTED.
State for = how long the customer has been in that state (since the exporter noticed).
Login = smppbox's own online/offline flag for the login.
Sessions / Max sessions = bound now / allowed (all bind types).
IPs = distinct source IPs bound.
Submit/s, Deliver/s = last 5 min rate. '(range)' means over the time range selected at top-right.
Fail % = failed / submitted. Open acks = in-flight PDUs.
Last reconnect = age of the newest session (small = customer reconnected recently).

Direction: 'Submit' = submit_sm PDUs the customer sends TO smppbox (MT traffic). 'Deliver' = deliver_sm PDUs smppbox sends TO the customer (delivery reports / MO).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((smppbox_esme_connected{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((time() - smppbox_esme_state_since_timestamp_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((smppbox_login_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"})) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_login_sessions_max{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"})) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[5m]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id) (increase(smppbox_esme_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id) group by (server, esme, smsc_id) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

panels.title: Top 10 customers by volume (range)
panels.description:
Customers with the most submitted messages in the selected time range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (esme) (increase(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 customers by failed (range)
panels.description:
Customers with the most failed messages in the selected time range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (esme) (increase(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Top 10 failure % (range, >100 msgs)
panels.description:
Worst failure percentage per customer. Customers with 100 or fewer messages in the range are excluded to avoid noise.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * sum by (esme) (increase(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) / (sum by (esme) (increase(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) > 100))

panels.title: Submit rate per customer
panels.description:
Messages/s each customer is submitting (stacked). Only customers with traffic are shown.

Direction: 'Submit' = submit_sm PDUs the customer sends TO smppbox (MT traffic). 'Deliver' = deliver_sm PDUs smppbox sends TO the customer (delivery reports / MO).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (server, esme) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Deliver (DLR/MO) rate per customer
panels.description:
Deliveries/s (DLR/MO) sent to each customer (stacked).

Direction: 'Submit' = submit_sm PDUs the customer sends TO smppbox (MT traffic). 'Deliver' = deliver_sm PDUs smppbox sends TO the customer (delivery reports / MO).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (server, esme) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Failed rate per customer
panels.description:
Failed messages per second per customer.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (server, esme) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Failure % per customer
panels.description:
Failed as % of submitted, per customer, over time.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, esme) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (server, esme) (rate(smppbox_esme_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Customer connection state (history)

targets.expr: smppbox_esme_connected{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}

panels.description:
Green = CONNECTED (at least one bind), red = DISCONNECTED, for every customer over the selected time range. Hover to see exact times of drops and reconnects.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

panels.title: Active sessions per customer
panels.description:
Number of binds each customer holds over time (all bind types). Dips mean sessions dropped.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (server, esme) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"})

panels.title: Open acks (in-flight) per customer
panels.description:
Unacknowledged PDUs per customer. Should stay low; a plateau at the window size means the link is congested.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (server, esme) (smppbox_esme_open_acks{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"})

panels.title: Session utilisation % (bound / allowed)
panels.description:
Bound sessions compared with the maximum allowed per bind type. 100 % = customer is using all allowed sessions and new binds will be rejected.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, esme) (smppbox_login_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}) / clamp_min(sum by (server, esme) (smppbox_login_sessions_max{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}) / 3, 1)

panels.title: Customer connections by bind type (Transceiver / Transmitter / Receiver)  -  $bind_type
Transceiver sessions
panels.description:
Open TRANSCEIVER binds (trcv). A transceiver bind can both submit messages and receive DLR/MO on the same connection.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type="trcv"})

panels.title: Transmitter sessions
panels.description:
Open TRANSMITTER binds (trans). Transmitter binds can only submit messages; the customer needs a receiver bind to get DLRs.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type="trans"})

panels.title: Receiver sessions
panels.description:
Open RECEIVER binds (recv). Receiver binds only receive DLR/MO, they never submit.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type="recv"})

panels.title: Binds (range)
panels.description:
Number of new SMPP binds (session connects) in the selected range for the selected bind types. Frequent binds mean the customer keeps reconnecting.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(increase(smppbox_esme_type_connects_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Unbinds / drops (range)
panels.description:
Number of sessions that disappeared (unbind, timeout, network drop) in the selected range. Orange > 5, red > 50.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(increase(smppbox_esme_type_disconnects_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Open acks (selected types)
panels.description:
In-flight (unacknowledged) PDUs on the selected bind types.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum(smppbox_esme_type_open_acks{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"})

panels.title: Customer stats per bind type
panels.description:
One row per customer per bind type:
Transceiver (trcv) = submit + receive on one bind; Transmitter (trans) = submit only; Receiver (recv) = DLR/MO only.
Sessions / Max allowed = bound now / allowed for that bind type.
Submit/s, Deliver/s = last 5 min. '(range)' means over the time range selected at top-right.
Binds / Drops = connects and disconnects in the range.
Oldest / Newest session = age of the longest-lived and the most recent session of that type.

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (rate(smppbox_esme_type_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range]))) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((100 * sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__range])), 1)) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_type_open_acks{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"})) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_type_session_uptime_max_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"})) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) ((sum by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_type_session_uptime_min_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"})) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, type) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

panels.title: Submit rate by bind type
panels.description:
Submits per second split by bind type (transmitter vs transceiver). Receiver binds never submit, so they stay at 0.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(smppbox_esme_type_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Deliver (DLR/MO) rate by bind type
panels.description:
Deliveries per second split by bind type (receiver vs transceiver). Transmitter binds never receive deliveries.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(smppbox_esme_type_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Active sessions by bind type
panels.description:
Open sessions per bind type over time (stacked).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (smppbox_esme_active_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"})

panels.title: Binds & drops per customer
panels.description:
Bars above zero = new binds, bars below zero = sessions dropped, per customer and bind type. Useful to spot flapping connections.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (esme, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_connects_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__interval])) > 0
-1 * (sum by (esme, type) (increase(smppbox_esme_type_disconnects_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Submit rate per customer & bind type
panels.description:
Submit rate for each customer split by the bind type carrying it.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (esme, type) (rate(smppbox_esme_type_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Connections by source IP
panels.description:
Every source IP each customer is connected from: sessions open from that IP, current rates and totals in the range. Sessions = 0 (red) means that IP was used recently but is not connected now.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) ((smppbox_esme_ip_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) (smppbox_esme_ip_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) ((rate(smppbox_esme_ip_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[5m])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) (smppbox_esme_ip_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) ((rate(smppbox_esme_ip_messages_sent_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[5m])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) (smppbox_esme_ip_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) ((increase(smppbox_esme_ip_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) (smppbox_esme_ip_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) ((increase(smppbox_esme_ip_messages_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) and on (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) group by (server, esme, smsc_id, ip) (smppbox_esme_ip_sessions{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}))

panels.title: Submit rate per source IP
panels.description:
Submit rate per customer source IP - shows how traffic is balanced across a customer's servers/IPs.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Customer filters at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (esme, ip) (rate(smppbox_esme_ip_messages_received_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Plugin chains
panels.description:
All plugins loaded in smppbox per trigger chain, in execution order (#). PDU_FROM_ESME = runs on PDUs received from customers, PDU_TO_ESME = runs on PDUs sent to customers. State should be 'active'.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_plugin_info{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: DB pool utilisation % (CDR / prepaid)
panels.description:
Share of database connections in use for the CDR and prepaid plugins. Near 100 % means the DB is a bottleneck.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - smppbox_plugin_db_connections_idle{server=~"$server"} / clamp_min(smppbox_plugin_db_connections_max{server=~"$server"}, 1))

panels.title: SQL statements in queue
panels.description:
CDR SQL statements waiting to be written to the database. Should be 0; a growing number means the DB cannot keep up.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_plugin_sql_queue{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: Inactive plugins
panels.description:
Plugins whose state is not 'active'. Should be 0.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: count(smppbox_plugin_active{server=~"$server"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Plugins loaded
panels.description:
Total plugins loaded across the selected servers.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: count(smppbox_plugin_active{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description:
How long the exporter needed to download and parse each status.xml. Should be well below the scrape interval.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: smppbox_scrape_duration_seconds{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: Scrape errors / min
panels.description:
Failed status page reads per minute (network error, timeout, wrong password).

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: 60 * rate(smppbox_scrape_errors_total{server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: Seconds since last good scrape
panels.description:
Time since the exporter last read each status page successfully. Grows while a server is unreachable.

Follows the Server filter only (gateway-wide numbers, not per customer).

targets.expr: time() - smppbox_last_scrape_success_timestamp_seconds{server=~"$server"} and smppbox_last_scrape_success_timestamp_seconds{server=~"$server"} > 0

list.name: bind_type
list.label: Bind type
list.description: trcv = transceiver (send+receive on one bind), trans = transmitter (send only), recv = receiver (DLR/MO only)
